title: ODOT Crash Data - 2023 - aggregate summary by area
text:
Aggregate crash summary by area - ODOT Crash Data - 2023 (2023).
- Delaware County: 3,482 crashes (5: 2,480, 3: 486, 4: 419, 2: 82, 1: 15).
- Fairfield County: 2,116 crashes (5: 1,536, 3: 308, 4: 177, 2: 80, 1: 15).
- Franklin County: 23,446 crashes (5: 16,003, 3: 4,121, 4: 2,659, 2: 545, 1: 118).
- Knox County: 1,051 crashes (5: 783, 3: 137, 4: 97, 2: 28, 1: 6).
- Licking County: 3,174 crashes (5: 2,360, 3: 415, 4: 284, 2: 98, 1: 17).
- Madison County: 1,065 crashes (5: 759, 3: 148, 4: 94, 2: 54, 1: 10).
- Morrow County: 881 crashes (5: 639, 3: 158, 4: 51, 2: 28, 1: 5).
- Pickaway County: 1,239 crashes (5: 870, 3: 193, 4: 112, 2: 57, 1: 7).
- Union County: 1,307 crashes (5: 958, 3: 167, 4: 139, 2: 35, 1: 8).
- Ohio statewide (all counties; NOT a Central Ohio figure): 252,570 crashes (5: 187,528, 3: 32,668, 4: 25,165, 2: 6,059, 1: 1,150).
Severity is shown as the layer's raw CRASH_SEVERITY_CD codes, which the layer publishes no lookup for; they are not decoded here. Computed on 2026-11-02 by counting records in the ArcGIS layer 'ODOT Crash Data - 2023' grouped by COUNTY_CD, CRASH_YR, CRASH_SEVERITY_CD. Source: https://tims.dot.state.oh.us/ags/rest/services/Safety/2023_Crash_Locations/MapServer/0
caveats: Aggregate counts only, computed server-side; individual crash records are not loaded in this knowledge base.
Severity values are the layer's raw codes (CRASH_SEVERITY_CD); no coded-value domain was published to decode them.
